messages:
leena: spotted a spike of websocket 1006 closes from a subset of tenants after the edge canary. Root cause appears to be a sequence of very small frames (~12-40B) being emitted by the proxy which some client libs treat as EOF and immediately reconnect (double-billing).

sam: is it WS only or SSE too?

leena: mostly WS on /v1/stream/chat (eu-west). A few SSE streams showed fragmented events. Packet capture shows repeated tiny writes containing compressed or plain JSON. Direct-to-runtime doesn't reproduce.

rahul: sounds like the recent http2 write-flush tweak on the proxy. Two safe options: revert the flush tweak (bigger perf impact) or coalesce tiny writes at the proxy. Coalesce seems lower blast radius but needs guardrails.

sam: agree. Make coalescing opt-in per-route behind a feature flag, add a CLI toggle for rollback, exempt single-byte heartbeats, and add metrics.

rahul: will prototype: buffer up to 64B or 50ms, forward early if buffer contains valid UTF-8/JSON. Emit metrics: stream.small_frame_count, stream.reconnect_rate, stream.coalesce_latency_ms (labels: route, tenant). Traces will annotate coalesced events but only include hashes+lengths (no payloads).

ops-bot: staging canary deployed edge-proxy/c-115 at 2026-03-23T12:40:00Z.

leena: staging test reduced reconnects from ~20/min -> ~2/min for the test set. p95 token latency increased ~8-12ms. Holding canary for 2 hours before staged rollout.

sam: great. UX ask: add simple "Stream health" card on the route page showing tiny-frame spikes and reconnect loops to avoid repeated paging. Also add alert on reconnect_rate > 5x baseline for 5m.

rahul: noted. I'll open PR and include tests and the CLI rollback flag. Will also add runbook steps for detecting and crediting duplicated streams.

leena: thanks all, will post updates if anything regresses.
